scientific.integrity: The proof starts from the published F-LLoM component survival and softmax mixture formulas. All asymptotic statements are derived analytically from finite sums of Lomax tails. The included numerical checker is a consistency test and is not used to prove the limits.
limitations: The theorem is first-order and conditional on a fixed finite covariate vector.
Tied minimum-shape components remain asymptotically ambiguous according to explicit tail-constant weights.
No uniform joint limit is claimed when covariates vary with the tail threshold.

title: Extreme survivors identify the heaviest F-LLoM tiers
